resources.name: Compiled input data for cubic GaN and AlN

access.notes: CSV file provided in task inputs at /inputs/input_data_for_gan_aln.csv. Contains lattice constants, atomic masses, elastic constants (C11, C12, C44), bulk modulus B0 and its pressure derivative B0', ambient and high-pressure critical-point phonon frequencies (Γ LO, TO; X TA, LA, LO, TO; L TA, LA, LO, TO), and estimated high-pressure X,L frequencies.
Install via pip: python3 -m pip install -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple numpy
Install via pip: python3 -m pip install -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple scipy
Optional; can be used to handle crystal structure and dynamical matrix construction. Install via pip.
